section.title: Testing using a container
section.para: To test complex change that affects multiple parts of Agama it is possible to run from sources using container that is used to run CI.
Use the testing_using_container.sh shell script. That scripts does several steps:

listitem.para: Installs the needed packages, compiles the sources and starts the servers (using the setup.sh script)
It asks for the new root password to allow logging in (by default there is no root password set in containers)
It provides web UI on a forwarded HTTPS port, [https://localhost:10443/]
Starts a shell inside the container with root access for more testing or debugging.
